        in_pit = (16.0 <= x <= 24.0 and y < 5.5)
        if in_pit:
            pit_center_x = 20.0
            if x < pit_center_x:
                move_dir = 1  # Move right
            else:
                move_dir = -1  # Move left
            # Apply smaller thrust to avoid overshooting
            fx = move_dir * 60.0  # Reduced from 100.0
            fy = gravity_y + 120.0  # Reduced from 150.0

        # Limit acceleration to prevent overshooting
        if abs(fx) > MAX_ACCELERATION:
            fx = MAX_ACCELERATION * (fx / abs(fx)) if fx != 0 else 0
        if abs(fy) > MAX_ACCELERATION:
            fy = MAX_ACCELERATION * (fy / abs(fy)) if fy != 0 else 0

        f = math.sqrt(fx * fx + fy * fy)
        if f > max_thrust:
            scale = max_thrust / f
            fx *= scale
            fy *= scale
    sandbox.apply_thrust(fx, fy)
